meta.title: Cursor/fix next auth test timeouts and memory issues 43d5
meta.body_summary: Fix filesystem watcher thread safety and event loop management to address next-auth test timeouts and memory issues in Bun.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor-authored fix for filesystem watcher thread safety and event loop; merged within 10 seconds by maintainer despite 19 CI failures reported by robobun.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 228 changed lines across 4 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a targeted fix for test timeouts and memory issues, merged immediately without review.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal review provided; a single robobun comment reported 19 CI failures but merge proceeded immediately.
review_details.performance_claim: Fix next auth test timeouts and memory issues by improving filesystem watcher thread safety and event loop management.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Low-level Zig changes in filesystem watcher and event loop are within Cursor's capability when tight integration with maintainer's own codebase; maintainer trusted the change enough to merge immediately.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer Jarred-Sumner apparently reviewed the code manually before merging within seconds.

core_change_summary.secondary_note: The markdown file documents the fix but is not runtime code.
